metadata.description: Annotation layer for indopak-nastaleeq-wbw.json / indopak-nastaleeq.json. It never changes or re-defines the Quran text; records are keyed by the WBW location.
metadata.grammar_source: Quranic Arabic Corpus / Quranic Treebank (data/Quranic/Quranic.csv); morphology v0.4 cross-checked by validate.py
metadata.null_policy: A source value "_" means no value; the JSON key is absent. lemma_ar / root_ar hold the placeholder "ـ" in the source whenever lemma / root is absent; it is re-created on round trip, not stored.
metadata.derived_policy: Everything under a "derived" key, plus the sentence-level "constituents" list, is computed by this project from original annotations; original annotations are never replaced.

derivation_rules.sentence_id: sentence of the first STEM segment; each segment keeps its own sentence id in syntax_ref
derivation_rules.verb_forms: only STEM segments with pos V. explicit: Form given in the Treebank. inferred: no Form given -> Form I (the default stated in CAMorphFeatures.xlsx). Form I is never explicit in the source.
derivation_rules.nominal_form_annotations: non-verb STEM segments that carry a verb_form value; never counted as verbs
derivation_rules.projections: whole-word labels joined with "+" in segment order. pos_stem / function_stem use STEM segments only; pos_all_segments / function_all use every segment; function_without_NonRel drops NonRel (a word whose only label is NonRel keeps "NonRel").

segments_pos_differs_from_morphology_v04.note: features_raw still carries the v0.4 POS; the Treebank pos column re-tags these segments (e.g. N -> T). The Treebank pos is the value stored in "pos".
